subject.title: ci: temporarily disable QA smoke again

question: Should maintainers accept a short-lived skip of automatic QA Smoke CI while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102262 repairs and re-enables the lane?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but it deliberately removes a required automation signal and only maintainers can decide whether the temporary coverage gap is acceptable.

options.title: Accept the short-lived kill switch
options.body: Merge this only if the follow-up re-enable path remains active and the temporary coverage gap is intentionally owned.

options.title: Pause for direct repair
options.body: Hold this PR and land a replacement that fixes QA Smoke sharding without a separate disabled window.

options.title: Close if superseded by the repair
options.body: Close this PR if the repair branch is retargeted to main and can re-enable QA Smoke in one step.

recommendation.title: Accept the short-lived kill switch
recommendation.body: Merge this only if the follow-up re-enable path remains active and the temporary coverage gap is intentionally owned.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa owns this PR and the stacked re-enable repair, and also carried the related scenario-repair context.
